launches.tagline: Eliminate 100s of hours from your property accounting workflows
launches.body:
Hi all, we’re Nick & Sam and the co-founders of [IronLedger](https://www.ironledger.ai/?utm_source=yc-launch&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=yc-launch-2025).

IronLedger provides AI agents for property accounting, starting with accounts payable. **We already eliminate 100s of hours of expense work for 1000s of multifamily units every month.**

If you know any property owners, managers or accountants, we can save them 100s of hours and $1000s in accounting spend per month. Reach out to [sales@ironledger.ai](mailto:sales@ironledger.ai) for them to take advantage of our special Launch Deal: _25% off your first month + cancel anytime (ends 08/08/25)._

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FHruoQipavM

# **Today, property accounting is a massive headache**

For every 1,000 multifamily units, someone on your accounting team is stuck analyzing 400+ transactions. They’re flipping between Yardi, Excel and Outlook, while texting property managers for more detail. It’s not uncommon for this process to take a full week of every month. Accounting teams also have to balance billbacks, bank reconciliations and dozens of other workflows. As an owner or manager, the stress of maintaining accurate financials and finding quality accountants, takes energy away from growing your business. 

Traditional thinking is to throw more headcount at the problem or outsource accounting. But these are expensive, time consuming, and low quality options.

# **Enter IronLedger**

IronLedger offers the first AI agents for property accounting. Using AI, IronLedger can read, code and collect relevant details from every transaction. It tracks invoices over email, receipts over text and proactively communicates directly with other humans (vendors, managers or maintenance teams) so you don’t have to. IronLedger makes your data immediately accessible, so accountants and asset managers can start closing your books in days, not weeks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92570&key=user_uploads/2556851/109de86c-2701-46e9-9eae-754dbc73cb02)

IronLedger also codes as well as your best accountant. Using thousands of historical transactions, the right context, and novel LLM techniques, we can code your expenses with >99% accuracy. Low confidence transactions are proactively flagged for review.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92570&key=user_uploads/2556851/98d16650-f1c6-429c-9777-ff476e537ea6)

Setup requires <2 hours of your time and IronLedger is immediately built into your existing team’s workflows. 

Stop your accounts payable headache today. Partner with [IronLedger](https://www.ironledger.ai/?utm_source=yc-launch&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=yc-launch-2025) ([sales@ironledger.com](mailto:sales@ironledger.com)).

# **About us**

Nick (CEO) was previously a consultant at Bain & Co and venture investor with Future Back Ventures. He is a passive real estate investor and his family developed & managed commercial real estate. Sam (CTO) was previously a tech lead at Rippling and built core Rippling HRIS systems as they scaled from 300 to 5K+ employees.
